# Test data sources

Every file under `testdata/` is listed here with its origin and license (NFR-029). Generated fixtures name the generator (test code or script) instead. Only files that anyone may use and redistribute are committed.

| File | Origin or generator | License | Added in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `web/tests/e2e/fixtures/clip.webm` | Generated by `web/tests/e2e/fixtures/make-media.py` (PyAV): VP8, 320×240, 10 fps, 12 s, a moving box | Project (AGPL-3.0-or-later); no third-party content | S02.8-T02 |
| `web/tests/e2e/fixtures/tone.webm` | Generated by the same script: Opus, 12 s of a 440 Hz tone | Project (AGPL-3.0-or-later); no third-party content | S02.8-T02 |

The system tests make every other file they use at run time (`web/tests/e2e/setup.ts`: a PNG, a PDF, text, HTML, SVG, and 50,000 empty files), and the Go and web unit tests make theirs in the test code.
